resources.string: Android System WebView needs an update
Blot runs inside Android System WebView, and the version on this device is too old to open it. Update it, then open Blot again.

Google\'s last security fixes for Android 9 came out in January 2022, so holes in Android found since then stay open on this phone. Blot redacts on the phone and sends your document nowhere, but an app that gets in through one of those holes could still read what is on the screen or in your files.
